newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were lower at the close on Wednesday, following German bonds down but still maintaining an edge over Bunds.
The 10-year yield spread to German bonds widened to 222 basis points from an already-wide 218 basis points on Tuesday.

One trader following the Swiss Confederate Bond futures, or "Conf" contract, said that there was still low volume in that market. He added during selloffs, Conf volume usually tended to increase as investors sought to hedge cash positions. But, he said, "people don't appear to be hedging."
"People are not hedging, because the market has always risen again," the trader added.
"What is making me nervous is that the Swiss market is outperforming Germany. Some people are saying the outperformance is because the Swiss economy is so weak compared with Germany," he said.
But, he also noted that the Swiss economy is highly dependent on Germany, and if there is any improvement in the German economy, Switzerland's economy is also likely to recover.
March Conf futures CONFH7 down 52 at 121.85.
March Comi medium-term bond COMIH7 down 17 at 112.58
Mar Euro Swiss francs FESH7 down 11 at 98.16.
